title: A QUANTIFIABLE INFORMATION-PROCESSING HIERARCHY PROVIDES A NECESSARY CONDITION FOR DETECTING AGENCY
reasoning: The paper explicitly proposes a framework to identify agency as a precursor to establishing moral status and ethical considerations. A significant portion of the discussion (Section 6.1) is dedicated to how the proposed hierarchy provides a theoretical foundation for inferring 'minimal agency' as a necessary component for moral standing and responsibility in both artificial and biological systems.
